title: 국군의무사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Appointment and Duties of the Commander, etc.)
(1) The Armed Forces Medical Command shall have one Commander and one Chief of Staff.
(2) The Commander shall be appointed from among general-grade officers (將星級), and the Chief of Staff shall be appointed from among general-grade or field-grade officers. <Amended on September 5, 2017>
(3) The Commander shall exercise overall control over the affairs of the Armed Forces Medical Command and command and supervise subordinate personnel and units or institutions.
(4) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Commander and act on behalf of the Commander where the Commander is unable to perform duties for unavoidable reasons.
